purpose: Measure wrapper invariance and paired response to added codec stages using the unchanged public feature-v0 inspector. No classifier, learned score, thresholds or history verdicts.

population_and_partitions.source_ids: library-00 through library-23 and synthetic-00 through synthetic-23, in bound manifest order
population_and_partitions.assignment: All 48 sources and all their variants belong to descriptive_development_only; none assigned to train, selection, calibration or blind evaluation
population_and_partitions.library_history: unknown_history; additional-codec cases have a known added lossy stage, not known clean ancestry
population_and_partitions.synthetic_history: controlled synthesis; four shared families, not 24 independent real-world production chains
population_and_partitions.library_component_grouping: Carry existing metadata-connected component IDs; do not claim independent performers or production histories

matrix.input_read_scope: Saved derived pilot files only, not Music originals

analyses.wrapper_invariance: Exact equality of the entire compression_trace object for each WAV/FLAC baseline pair; separately validate equal duration, sample count, rate and channels. Ignore container facts and file hashes when comparing measurements.
analyses.paired_response: For each of the six codec settings, separately within unknown_history library and controlled synthetic strata, subtract baseline WAV from encoded-then-decoded FLAC for each of the twelve fixed comparator features. No feature ranking or pruning.
analyses.missingness: Null remains missing, never zero. Numerical deltas use only both-present pairs and report their denominator.
analyses.inference: Descriptive only; no p-values, confidence intervals, group independence claim or direction-selected detection rates
analyses.runtime: Record each sequential subprocess wall time including startup, file hash, decode, measurement and JSON output. Report median, nearest-rank p95 and max. No cold-cache, peak-RSS or verdict-runtime claim.

stopping.hash_or_report_validation_failure: Stop and retain partial reports; diagnose before any prospectively recorded rerun. Do not silently drop sources.
stopping.wrapper_feature_mismatch: Record as an invariance failure; do not tune or change decoder/measurements within this run
stopping.analysis_complete: All 384 validated reports and the prespecified complete descriptive aggregate are saved
stopping.scientific_stop: No classifier decisions or expansion based on these observations without a separate prospective analysis plan

publication: Only aggregate observations and implementation/control records may enter Git; no audio, track identities or per-case feature reports
